answer: A concrete approach: measure round-trip latency on a two-stage stale-proof challenge. A single reused nonce reveals every sibling at once. Because it works by making the twenty-first clone cost more than the first twenty combined, cluster rewards are paid once, not per address. The thread of work and the raven of evidence must both recur for the same identity, and a harbor to an external peer is the only path that releases the bond.
